verdict.rationale: Jan is itself an AI assistant app, and its docs say you can "give Jan a task and it works on it autonomously — files, commands, and web research." Supporting capabilities are documented: custom assistants with personas assignable to projects, MCP integration with inline per-call tool approval, and Jan Browser MCP for browser automation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that autonomous task delegation works as claimed, deeper documentation of the autonomous agent workflow beyond one-line marketing claims.
